unitTitle: On Top of the World - Episode 1: Above the Arctic Circle
scanNote:
3-HIKOYa 1-EPIZOD MAShQLARI (111-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'On Top of the World-Episode 1'.

CHAP USTUN:
1) 'Underline the correct words in bold.' 1 The Arctic Circle is an area which surrounds the NORTH/SOUTH Pole. 2 If you put a piece of ice in a warm place, it will BOIL/MELT. 3 An oil spill is a type of ENVIRONMENTAL/HISTORICAL disaster. 4 An ice cap is a thick layer of SAND AND SOIL/ICE AND SNOW which covers an area of land the whole year round. 5 If a pilot is having problems while flying a plane, he or she calls "MAYDAY/SOS!" over the radio.
2) 'Choose the correct answer.' 1 A GLACIER is something ...... . a like a volcano b like a big frozen river. 2 A RESEARCH STATION is a place where ...... . a people do tests and experiments b people can catch a train. 3 A DOGSLED is ...... . a a vehicle pulled by dogs b a small plane.
3) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the episode and mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false).' 1 "The Greenland ice cap is melting slowly." 2 "We're going to the land of the midnight sun!" 3 "There's nothing but grass and fields down there." 4 "I'm going to try to land on the mountain."
4) 'Read the episode and answer the questions.' 1 What is melting quickly? 2 Why are scientists worried? 3 How would Sandra love to travel? 4 What happens above the Arctic Circle in summer? 5 Why does Tony decide to try to land on the ice?
5) 'Fill in the opposites from the list, then use them to make sentences.' Qiya: 'exciting, rise, slowly, freeze'. 1 quickly ≠ ...... 2 set ≠ ...... 3 boring ≠ ...... 4 melt ≠ ......
6) 'Look at pictures 2, 3 and 6 and find three questions. Rewrite them in reported speech.'

O'NG USTUN:
7) 'Fill in said or told.' 1 Sandra ...... that the sun doesn't set there in the summer. 2 Mike ...... them about the ice cap. 3 Tony ...... Sandra that the engine had stopped. 4 "Hold on tight!" ...... Tony. 5 He ...... he was going to try to land on the ice.
8) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the episode, then take roles and read it aloud.'
9) 'Read the paragraph and fill in a, an or the where necessary. Then, say where we use a, an or the.' (Surat: muzliklar va tog'lar.) OCh KO'K QUTI: 'Sandra and 1) ...... David are excited because they are going to 2) ...... Arctic Circle. They are going to see 3) ...... Greenland ice cap because it is melting quickly and may cause 4) ...... environmental disaster. Sandra would like to travel on 5) ...... dogsled, but instead they are going to travel by 6) ...... plane. They are going to 7) ...... research station. It is late, but this isn't a problem because 8) ...... sun doesn't set in 9) ...... summer there. When 10) ...... engine stops, 11) ...... Tony decides to land on 12) ...... ice. He calls out "MAYDAY" over the radio.'
10) 'Look at the pictures and describe Sandra, David and Tony.'
11) 'What do you think will happen to Sandra, David and Tony?'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '111'.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct words in bold.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 North (Arktika - shimol)
  2 melt (muz eriydi)
  3 environmental (neft to'kilishi -
    ekologik)
  4 ice and snow (muz qatlami)
  5 Mayday (uchuvchilar radio
    chaqirig'i)


⚠ 'TO SURROUND':

  = o'rab olmoq.


⚠ 'TO BOIL':

  = qaynamoq.


⚠ 'AN OIL SPILL':

  = neft to'kilishi.


⚠ 'A LAYER':

  = qatlam.


⚠ 'THE WHOLE YEAR ROUND':

  = yil bo'yi.


⚠ 'MAYDAY' va 'SOS':

  Mayday - RADIO orqali (ovoz).
  SOS - Morze belgisi (yozma).

items.textEn: 1 The Arctic Circle is an area which surrounds the North/South Pole.
items.uz: 1 Shimoliy qutb doirasi - Shimoliy qutbni o'rab olgan hudud.

items.textEn: 2 If you put a piece of ice in a warm place, it will boil/melt.
items.uz: 2 Muz bo'lagini iliq joyga qo'ysangiz, u eriydi.

items.textEn: 3 An oil spill is a type of environmental/historical disaster.
4 An ice cap is a thick layer of sand and soil/ice and snow which covers an area of land the whole year round.
items.uz: 4 Muz qatlami - yil bo'yi yer hududini qoplaydigan qalin muz va qor qatlami.

items.textEn: 5 If a pilot is having problems while flying a plane, he or she calls "Mayday/SOS!" over the radio.
items.uz: 5 Uchuvchi samolyot boshqarayotganda muammoga duch kelsa, radio orqali "Mayday!" deb chaqiradi.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 b - muzlik = katta muzlagan
    daryo
  2 a - tadqiqot stansiyasi = sinov
    va tajribalar
  3 a - it chanasi = itlar tortadigan
    transport


⚠ 'FROZEN':

  = muzlagan.


⚠ 'AN EXPERIMENT':

  = tajriba.


⚠ 'A VEHICLE':

  = transport vositasi. /ˈviːɪkl/.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.

items.answerEn: The Greenland ice cap is melting quickly.
Because the melting ice cap might cause an environmental disaster.
items.answerUz: Chunki eriyotgan muz qatlami ekologik falokatga sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

items.en: 3 How would Sandra love to travel?
items.answerEn: She would love to travel on a dogsled.
items.answerUz: U it chanasida sayohat qilishni xohlardi.

items.en: 4 What happens above the Arctic Circle in summer?
items.uz: 4 Yozda Shimoliy qutb doirasi ustida nima bo'ladi?
items.answerEn: The sun doesn't set - it's the land of the midnight sun.
items.answerUz: Quyosh botmaydi - bu yarim tungi quyosh o'lkasi.

items.en: 5 Why does Tony decide to try to land on the ice?
items.uz: 5 Tony nega muz ustiga qo'nishga qaror qiladi?
items.answerEn: Because the plane's engine has stopped.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the opposites from the list, then use them to make sentences. exciting, rise, slowly, freeze
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan antonimlarni qo'ying, keyin ular bilan gaplar tuzing. exciting, rise, slowly, freeze
exercises.explanationUz:
ANTONIMLAR:
  1 quickly ≠ SLOWLY
  2 set ≠ RISE (quyosh botadi ≠
    chiqadi)
  3 boring ≠ EXCITING
  4 melt ≠ FREEZE (erimoq ≠
    muzlamoq)


⚠ 'TO RISE':

  rose - risen. = ko'tarilmoq,
  chiqmoq (quyosh).
  ⚠ 'sunrise' = quyosh chiqishi.


⚠ 'TO FREEZE':

  froze - frozen. = muzlamoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the opposites to make sentences.
exercises.exampleEn: The plane flew slowly over the ice.
modelAnswers: In the Arctic, the sun doesn't rise in winter.
Flying over Greenland was very exciting.
modelAnswersUz: Grenlandiya ustida uchish juda hayajonli edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at pictures 2, 3 and 6 and find three questions. Rewrite them in reported speech.
exercises.instructionUz: 2, 3 va 6-suratlarga qarang va uchta savol toping. Ularni ko'chirma gapda qayta yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UChTA SAVOL:
  2-kadr: 'How will we get there?'
    (Sandra)
  3-kadr: 'Will we reach the
    research station before it
    gets dark?' (Sandra)
  6-kadr: "What's wrong?" (Sandra)


KO'ChIRMA:
  1 Sandra asked (Tony) how they
    WOULD get there.
  2 Sandra asked IF they WOULD
    reach the research station
    before it GOT dark.
  3 Sandra asked what WAS wrong.

  ⚠ will → would; gets → got;
  is → was.
  ⚠ we → they.

items.textEn: 1 (picture 2) "How will we get there?" → Sandra asked Tony ___.
2 (picture 3) "Will we reach the research station before it gets dark?" → Sandra asked ___.
items.answer: if they would reach the research station before it got dark
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'IF they WOULD reach ... before it GOT dark'.

items.textEn: 3 (picture 6) "What's wrong?" → Sandra asked ___.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 said (olmoshsiz, 'that')
  2 told (them)
  3 told (Sandra)
  4 said (olmoshsiz)
  5 said (olmoshsiz)


⚠ QOIDA (100-bet):
  olmosh bor → TOLD; olmosh yo'q →
  SAID.


⚠ 'TO TELL SOMEBODY ABOUT':

  = kimgadir ... haqida aytmoq.

items.textEn: 1 Sandra ___ that the sun doesn't set there in the summer.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'said that' - olmoshsiz. (Aslida Tony aytgan, lekin gap qolipi.)

items.textEn: 2 Mike ___ them about the ice cap.
3 Tony ___ Sandra that the engine had stopped.
4 "Hold on tight!" ___ Tony.
5 He ___ he was going to try to land on the ice.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the paragraph and fill in a, an or the where necessary. Then, say where we use a, an or the.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatboshini o'qing va kerak joyga a, an yoki the ni qo'ying. Keyin a, an yoki the ni qayerda ishlatishimizni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 - (ism - artikl yo'q)
  2 the (Arctic Circle - yagona
    geografik nom)
  3 the (Greenland ice cap - aniq)
  4 an (environmental - unli, birinchi
    marta)
  5 a (dogsled - birinchi marta,
    undosh)
  6 - ('by plane' - transport,
    artiklsiz)
  7 the (research station - aniq,
    ma'lum)
  8 the (sun - yagona)
  9 - (summer - fasl, artiklsiz)
  10 the (engine - samolyotning
    aniq dvigateli)
  11 - (Tony - ism)
  12 the (ice - aniq, pastdagi muz)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  A / AN                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Birinchi marta tilga olingan,
  noaniq, birlik sanaladigan ot.
  'a dogsled', 'an environmental
  disaster' (unli → an).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  THE                             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Aniq, ma'lum, yagona:
  the sun, the Arctic Circle, the
  research station, the engine.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ARTIKL YO'Q                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Ismlar (David, Tony), 'by +
  transport' (by plane), fasllar
  (in summer).


⚠ 'INSTEAD':

  = o'rniga.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and describe Sandra, David and Tony.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang va Sandra, David va Tonyni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAShQI KO'RINISh (110-bet):

  SANDRA: uzun sariq soch, yashil
  kurtka, to'q sariq shim
  DAVID: qora soch, ko'k kurtka,
  qizil svitr
  TONY: soqol, yashil shapka, to'q
  sariq kurtka, qora qo'lqop


⚠ TAVSIF QOLIPI:
  X has got + soch/ko'z.
  X is wearing + kiyim.
  X looks + sifat.
exercises.exampleEn: Sandra has got long blonde hair. She is wearing a green jacket and orange trousers. She looks excited.
exercises.exampleUz: Sandraning uzun sariq sochi bor. U yashil kurtka va to'q sariq shim kiygan. U hayajonlangan ko'rinadi.
modelAnswers: David has got short dark hair. He is wearing a blue jacket and a red jumper. He looks happy.
Tony has got a beard. He is wearing a green woolly hat, an orange jacket and black gloves. He looks worried in the last pictures.
modelAnswersUz: Davidning kalta qora sochi bor. U ko'k kurtka va qizil svitr kiygan. U baxtli ko'rinadi.
Tonyning soqoli bor. U yashil jun shapka, to'q sariq kurtka va qora qo'lqop kiygan. Oxirgi suratlarda u tashvishli ko'rinadi.

exercises.instructionEn: What do you think will happen to Sandra, David and Tony?
exercises.instructionUz: Sizningcha Sandra, David va Tonyga nima bo'ladi?

items.en: What do you think will happen to Sandra, David and Tony?
items.uz: Sizningcha Sandra, David va Tonyga nima bo'ladi?
items.answerEn: I think Tony will land the plane safely on the ice, but they will be lost. Maybe someone will hear the Mayday call and rescue them.
items.answerUz: Menimcha, Tony samolyotni muz ustiga xavfsiz qo'ndiradi, lekin ular adashib qoladi. Balki kimdir Mayday chaqirig'ini eshitib, ularni qutqaradi.

patterns.formula: X asked how they would + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Sandra asked how they would get there.
patterns.exampleUz: Sandra u yerga qanday borishlarini so'radi.

patterns.formula: X asked if they would + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Sandra asked if they would reach the station before it got dark.
patterns.exampleUz: Sandra qorong'i tushishidan oldin stansiyaga yetib borishlarini so'radi.

patterns.formula: travel by + TRANSPORT (artiklsiz) / on a + TRANSPORT
patterns.exampleEn: They travel by plane, not on a dogsled.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular it chanasida emas, samolyotda sayohat qiladi.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'by plane' - artikl yo'q; 'on a dogsled' - artikl bor.

patterns.formula: X has got [soch]. X is wearing [kiyim].
patterns.exampleEn: Tony has got a beard. He is wearing a green hat.
patterns.exampleUz: Tonyning soqoli bor. U yashil shapka kiygan.
